rrdcached_user.description: The system user running the rrdcached daemon. Usually 'rrdcached' or 'root'.

rrdcached_group.description: The system group associated with the rrdcached user.

rrdcached_socket_path.description: The path to the Unix domain socket used for IPC.

rrdcached_journal_path.description: Directory path for storing journal files to ensure data integrity.

rrdcached_work_path.description: The base directory where RRD files are stored.

rrdcached_daemonize.description: Enable background execution of the daemon.

rrdcached_buffer_limit.description: The maximum number of updates to buffer in memory before flushing.

rrdcached_journal_mode.description: Enable journaling for crash recovery ('yes' or 'no').
